evidence: The thickness, refractive index, and extinction coefficient (k) of the ALD deposited SnO2 and SnO films were measured by spectroscopic ellipsometry in the wavelength range of 275 –826 nm (SE, Horiba scientific, UVISEL). The chemical binding properties and O/Sn composition ratios of the SnO2 and SnO films were examined using X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS, Thermo Scientific, K-alpha) with Al Kα monochromatic X-ray source. The crystallinity of the SnO2 and SnO films was investigated by ex-situ GAXRD. The topography of the SnOx film surfaces was measured by atomic force microscopy (AFM, DI-3100, Veeco). The transmittance of the films in visible light was measured using UV–Vis spectroscopy (Shimadzu, UV-1800). The electrical properties of the deposited films were examined using Hall measurements. For in-situ analysis of the surface chemical reaction during the SnO2 and SnO ALD processes, a quadrupole mass spectrometer (QMS, Balzers, ABB Extrel MEXM-1000) was connected to the deposition system.
